proposals.evidence: CDIAL 2528 addendum explicitly places Bengali kabe and Hindi kab when? with western Pahari kεbε, through remodeling of the ēvam ēva temporal-adverb family with interrogative ka. The selected kəbə/kebe/keb/kebey/kebəy/kob responses fit these regional kab/kebe forms. This is the dictionary’s analogical-family analysis, not unmodified inheritance from just so; vowel and final-glide variation and local Indo-Aryan transmission remain unresolved. Exact response: kob.
